DRAWING NOTES:
1. LABELING STANDARDS SHALL BE FOLLOWED FOR TR NUMBER, RACK NUMBER, PATCH PANEL (A-Z),
AND PORT NUMBER. EXAMPLE: TR1-1A-01.
2. 8P8C CONNECTIONS IN WALL PLATES SHALL BE COLOR CODED BASED ON TYPE. REFER TO SHEET
T-001 FOR CABLE COLOR CHART.
3. LABEL ALL CABLES AND PORTS ON BOTH ENDS WITH COMPUTER GENERATED, SELF-LAMINATING,
ADHESIVE, WRAPAROUND LABELS. COORDINATE LABEL INFORMATION STANDARDS WITH VA IT
PERSONNEL PRIOR TO CONSTRUCTION.
4. CONTRACTOR SHALL PROVIDE CABLE PULL SCHEDULE FOR EACH SWITCH IN ALL RACKS AS PART OF
SHOP DRAWING SUBMITTAL.
5. PROVIDE FIBER OPTIC CABLE SERVICE LOOP, (1) FULL LOOP IN CABLE TRAY AROUND PERIMETER OF
DATA ROOM PRIOR TO TERMINATION IN RACK.
6. DO NOT INSTALL UTP CABLING ON TOP OF FIBER CABLING TO PREVENT DAMAGE TO THE FIBER
TRANSMISSION MEDIUM.
7. REFER TO SHEET T-501 TYPICAL RACK ELEVATIONS FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION.
8. CONTRACTOR SHALL PROVIDE ALL PATCH CABLING, INCLUDING COPPER AND FIBER-OPTIC, TO
ENSURE A FULLY FUNCTIONAL SYSTEM.
